quote: When two vehicles enter an intersection at approximately the same time, one vehicle traveling on a highway which ends at the intersection and the other vehicle traveling on a through highway, the driver of the vehicle on the highway which ends at the intersection shall yield the right-of-way to the other vehicle. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

activation.condition: Two vehicles enter an intersection approximately together, one on an ending highway and one on a through highway.

obligation.description: Driver on the highway that ends at the intersection yields right-of-way to the through-highway vehicle.

exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices
exceptions.condition: Governing official device, subject to subsection 4.

exceptions.source_clause: or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn
exceptions.condition: Opposite-direction approach with intended or realized left turn.

timing.description: Intersection approach and entry by both vehicles.
